inspection.question: Does validating real external SMTP change the already-certified operator UX?
evidence: frontend/e2e/fase7-correo.spec.ts validates the existing invoice email interaction and user feedback at the UI boundary.
That E2E intentionally mocks the HTTP response and therefore remains valid only as isolated UX evidence, not as proof of external SMTP delivery.
The missing N8.5 proof is provider/runtime integration beneath the existing send action; no new UI contract is required to perform it.
inspection.scopeDecision: Causal N/A for frontend/UX code. Preserve existing UX and route real-send proof exclusively to N8.5.G.
